<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/nav-menu.php';

$home = get_page_by_path( 'beranda', OBJECT, 'page' );
$guides = get_page_by_path( 'panduan-wisata', OBJECT, 'page' );
if ( $home ) {
    update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
    update_option( 'page_on_front', $home->ID );
}
if ( $guides ) {
    update_option( 'page_for_posts', $guides->ID );
}

// The WXR export does not include WordPress navigation menus. Build the
// primary menu explicitly so Playground matches the configured local site.
$menu_name = 'Travel Aja Primary';
$menu      = wp_get_nav_menu_object( $menu_name );
$menu_id   = $menu ? (int) $menu->term_id : wp_create_nav_menu( $menu_name );
if ( ! is_wp_error( $menu_id ) ) {
    $menu_id = (int) $menu_id;
    if ( empty( wp_get_nav_menu_items( $menu_id ) ) ) {
        $menu_pages = array(
            'beranda',
            'destinasi',
            'paket-wisata',
            'transportasi',
            'panduan-wisata',
            'tentang-kami',
        );
        foreach ( $menu_pages as $position => $slug ) {
            $page = get_page_by_path( $slug, OBJECT, 'page' );
            if ( ! $page ) {
                continue;
            }
            wp_update_nav_menu_item(
                $menu_id,
                0,
                array(
                    'menu-item-title'     => get_the_title( $page ),
                    'menu-item-object'    => 'page',
                    'menu-item-object-id' => (int) $page->ID,
                    'menu-item-type'      => 'post_type',
                    'menu-item-status'    => 'publish',
                    'menu-item-position'  => $position + 1,
                )
            );
        }
    }
    $locations            = get_theme_mod( 'nav_menu_locations', array() );
    $locations['primary'] = $menu_id;
    set_theme_mod( 'nav_menu_locations', $locations );
}
